officialName: Request or Claim Regarding Mention of Inventor as Such in a Patent
purpose: Either (a) request/claim that a person be mentioned as an inventor in a patent application/patent, or (b) declare that a named person ought not to have been mentioned as inventor and apply for a certificate to that effect, with a statement of circumstances attached.

layout.notes: Two-column form: left column carries the numbered instructions (1-5); right column carries the form with superscript markers. The right column offers two mutually exclusive declarations joined by 'or' (be mentioned / ought not to have been mentioned).

sections.title: Applicant Particulars
sections.description: Instruction 1: names, address and nationality of the person making this application.

autofill.derivation: Choose 'I' for a single applicant, 'We' for multiple.

fields.label: Name, address and nationality of the person(s) making this application
fields.helpText: Full name (family/principal name first), complete address incl postal index no./code and state, and nationality.

validation.message: Enter the applicant's name, address and nationality.

sections.title: Declaration
sections.description: Choose one of the two mutually exclusive declarations. Field order and wording follow the printed form; both declarations reference the same person, patent and applicant particulars below.

options.label: state/claim that the following person(s) be mentioned as inventor(s)
declare that the following person ought not to have been mentioned as inventor and apply for a certificate to that effect

fields.label: Person to be mentioned / not to be mentioned as inventor

fields.text: in respect of Patent application / Patent No.

validation.patternMessage: Enter the application or patent number.

fields.text: A Statement setting out the circumstances under which this application is made is attached together with the copy/copies thereof as required under the rules.

sections.title: Address for Service in India
sections.description: Instruction 3: complete address incl postal index number/code and state along with telephone and fax number(s).

fields.label: My/Our address for service in India
fields.helpText: Must be an address in India. Include postal index no./code, state, and telephone and fax number(s).

validation.message: Enter an address for service in India.

sections.title: To be signed by the applicant or authorised registered patent agent.

autofill.derivation: Default to the preparation / signing date; editable.

sections.title: Name of the natural person who has signed.

fields.label: Name of the natural person who has signed

validation.message: Enter the full name of the natural person who signed.

fields.text:
To
The Controller of Patents,
The Patent Office,
at

autofill.derivation: Jurisdictional patent office based on the applicant's address or the office recorded on Form 1.

attachments.label: Statement setting out the circumstances under which this application is made, with the copy/copies required under the rules
attachments.note: The statement of circumstances must accompany the request.

notes: Note. - For fee: See First Schedule.
Note. - Strike out whichever is not applicable.
The form serves both the inclusion and the exclusion of an inventor mention; select the applicable declaration.
A statement setting out the circumstances (with copies) must accompany the request.
